name: NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU datasheet
notes: Direct PDF fetch (doc 2287922, May 22). Max TDP 700W for H100 SXM and 350W for H100 PCIe. Crucially the form-factor row reads 'PCIe dual-slot air-cooled' for H100 PCIe vs 'SXM' for H100 SXM - the air-cooled qualifier is attached to the SKU form factor, not the architecture, which is exactly the distinction that decides whether a colo can host a part.
